reason: Hierarchy (SPEC.md:111) maps to test_fr04.py:96 and :99, which fail if any read/write/admin key combination is allowed or denied wrongly, and to :100, which fails unless exactly 6 of the 9 combinations are allowed. Below-scope 403 (SPEC.md:112) maps to :108, where a read key on POST /v1/tasks must be 403. Problem+json (SPEC.md:112) maps to :119 and :121. No existence leak (SPEC.md:112) maps to :124 and :158, which compare the 403 body for an existing id against the body for an unknown id. :175 shows no repo lookup happens before the 403. The single dependency (SPEC.md:113) maps to :141-:143, which fail if any /v1 route lacks require_scope or if more than one distinct dependency appears. :146 fixes the route count at 7, which matches the SPEC endpoint tables (4 task routes, run, runs and metrics). Residual weakness: only one probe per scope level is exercised, so the per-endpoint required scope for run, runs, metrics and GET by id is not asserted here. That does not leave any FR-04 normative sentence without a failing assertion.

gaps.message: Required scope is probed only for GET /v1/tasks, POST /v1/tasks and DELETE /v1/tasks/{id}. The scopes for run, runs, GET by id and metrics are not asserted in test_fr04.py.
